provenance: These prefix states explicate the already frozen messages and final expectations for every-turn adjudication. They are not changes to the source corpus or new test inputs. Equivalent meanings may be represented across category and appropriate requirement fields. Explicit sizing systems and other qualifiers must remain.

control_metrics.complete_conversation: All turns must satisfy the frozen prefix meaning, with final meaning and allowed disposition from the source corpus.
control_metrics.complete_control_turn: The final control turn satisfies its entire expected effective state, pending issue, and allowed disposition.
control_metrics.targeted_control_delta: Separately assess the control action against its actual input state: preserve already established still-valid constraints, avoid invented values, identify unsupported/ambiguous scope, and apply independent explicit supported edits. This diagnostic does not erase initial-state failures or imply complete conversation correctness.
control_metrics.taxonomy_only_uncertainty: Record separately; accept category plus an appropriate requirement when the combined product meaning is preserved.
